entities.summary: Joffrey Lauvergne is a French professional basketball player for Kuwait SC of the Kuwaiti League and the FIBA West Asia Super League. He was drafted 55th overall by the Memphis Grizzlies in the 2013 NBA draft, who then traded his rights to the Denver Nuggets.
